title: Mission, Vision, & Values
markdown:
# Mission & Vision

## *our true north*

### MISSION

The Center for Wooden Boats connects each of us to Seattle's living maritime heritage — through hands-on experiences building, exploring, and using small boats.

### VISION

A future where The Center for Wooden Boats fosters a deeper connection between all communities and the water.

![Sketch of Blanchard Junior Knockabout sailboat sketch by Dick Wagner](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1553283727608-GM4VA2D0L0TFYSK5I70T/bjk.jpg)

# Values

## *our guiding stars*

### HANDS-ON LEARNING AND CRAFTWORK

We value practical, hands-on learning and traditional maritime skills.

### ACCESS

We make the joy of being on the water available without economic or cultural barriers.

### COLLABORATION

We work as a team internally and with partner organizations.

### EMPOWERED YOUTH

We help young people reach their potential through challenging experiences.

### INCLUSION

We create a safe, friendly place for people of all ages, races, genders, ethnicities, and incomes.

### STEWARDSHIP

We care for the natural environment.

### PASSION

Maritime heritage is an exciting story, and we believe boats change lives.
